method: For each of 8 source records, use inline comparator lowerCase(trim(input)) against acceptable_answers; test exact, upper-case+padded, empty, wrong inflection, extraneous trailing token.

specific_checks.reason: Sentence has plural subject Many online ____.

limitations: Checks exercise a local comparator over GitHub JSON, not actual main-app scorer.
No independent QA of linguistic answer uniqueness or alternate semantically viable completions.
No integration, browser or production release tests performed.
